section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: The Contractor shall demolish and remove the abandoned warehouse foundations (E 300-360, N 20-60), protect the Owner's meteorological mast and groundwater wells, and keep clear of the buried 11 kV cable along the east boundary until the Owner has had it relocated (ALP-OWN-GEN-001 section 2).
title: Existing features on the Site
